title: Among female patients diagnosed with SLE who had laboratory tests in 1984 a
question: Among female patients diagnosed with SLE who had laboratory tests in 1984 and were under 50 years old at the time of testing, identify the patient with the highest hemoglobin level. Return her ID, sex, age at the time of the laboratory test, diagnosis, and whether her uric acid level was within the normal range for females (UA > 6.5).

prediction.sql: SELECT T1."XCL_058", T1."XCL_059", T2."XCL_016", T1."XCL_064", CASE WHEN T2."XCL_022" > 6.5 THEN 'No' ELSE 'Yes' END FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_014" WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'F' AND T1."XCL_064" = 'SLE' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2."XCL_015") = '1984' AND T2."XCL_016" < 50 ORDER BY T2."XCL_032" DESC LIMIT 1

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_058", T1."XCL_059", T2."XCL_016", T1."XCL_064",
       CASE WHEN T2."XCL_020" > 6.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_014"
WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND T1."XCL_064" = 'SLE'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2."XCL_015") = '1984'
  AND T2."XCL_016" < 50
ORDER BY T2."XCL_018" DESC
LIMIT 1;

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    p.XCL_058 AS patient_id,
    p.XCL_059 AS sex,
    (julianday(l.XCL_015) - julianday(p.XCL_060)) / 365.25 AS age_at_test,
    e.XCL_008 AS diagnosis,
    CASE WHEN l.XCL_035 > 6.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS uric_acid_normal
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.XCL_058 = l.XCL_014
JOIN Examination e ON p.XCL_058 = e.XCL_001
WHERE p.XCL_059 = 'F'
  AND e.XCL_008 = 'SLE'
  AND l.XCL_015 BETWEEN '1984-01-01' AND '1984-12-31'
  AND (julianday(l.XCL_015) - julianday(p.XCL_060)) / 365.25 < 50
ORDER BY l.XCL_035 DESC
LIMIT 1
